suggestions.text: Favicon test checks link hrefs only; assert public/ favicon bytes equal the brand files
Strip the ~7 KB c2pa <metadata> blob from public/favicon.svg
Layout title still falls back to 'Laravel' in config('app.name', 'Laravel')
line() keeps markup and control/zero-width chars; strip_tags and \p{C} so kicker/title are safe in any non-Blade consumer (PDF, export)
Escaping test uses inline Blade::render; add a real supplement page and PDF render test asserting <script> for kicker/title
Comment the second trim() after mb_substr in line()
Limiter is hit before the pending query; consider hitting only when rows were queued; Livewire callers must pass auth()->id() only
variant_name is model output without a character allowlist; consider letters/digits/.-_>* and space only
Add LookupStatus::isQueueable() for the [Pending, Failed] claimable rule used in QueueLookups and LookUpAll
Add a mixed LookingUp + Pending case to show the skip
Add a no-dark: guard test over app and module views
Dropzone has no upload progress; add an optional progress prop (0-100) with a thin bar
Segmented item is ~36px tall; HANDOFF wants 44px hit targets (min-h-11), also affects x-tabs
Showcase test list omits x-ui.page-header, x-ui.section, x-ui.copies
Assert callsLast24h/costLast24hUsd for Week and All windows
Extract a private profileConfig($name) helper shared by get() and labelFor()
Build the active status list from ResearchStatus::isActive() instead of hard-coding it
Replace the phpstan-only null research continue with an assert
Tie the 8pt check to the brand span rather than the minimum font-size in the markup
Arch test that Modules\Shared imports no other module
topForUser and VariantLinks each read the profile and catalog; cache per request if both are used on one page
Fake repeats topForUser's filter/sort/slice; extract a shared ranking helper if a third caller appears
HTTP-level test that a guest Livewire update to genetics::profile (e.g. lookUp) is rejected by persistent auth middleware
Sidebar fixed at 240px vs design flex 1 1 210px; user row name should be 16px/500 and initials 10px; check mobile sheet open/close in a browser
Title test misses the supplement show page
Batch per-row relevance lookups for the catalog match count if the catalog grows
x-ui.button hardcodes type=button; accept a type prop so form submits can use it
Real relevance reader should return empty for userId <= 0 as defence in depth behind @auth in slots
Browser check of the summary Read more clamp (Alpine only)
Pin escaping of variantName and genotypeEffect with a <script> payload render test
Guest call('lookUpAll') expects 401
Row link on md+ only selects; consider a direct Open affordance per row
hasLookingUp duplicates counts['looking_up'] and groupOptions recomputes counts(); derive from one source
Hide or disable Look up now when nothing is Pending or Failed
Render recommendations::genetic-panel as a guest directly; assert no data-genotype/data-allele and the sign-in prompt
Your genes panel is absent on Overview while research is null/active/failed; decide whether to show a placeholder
Bogus window test should assert usageWindow resolves to All, or normalise $window on mount/update
Per-window calls test uses assertSeeInOrder(['Calls','1']); assert on the data-stat=calls value (1 vs 2)
Use UsageWindow::label() instead of an inline label array in the template
Header subtitle counts supplements via all() (research rows only) while the stat uses total(); expose one count on a Supplements contract
Seed fakes at user id 0 in the match-stat, variant-stat and Home guest tests so the computed-property guard is exercised
match-stat uses a silent ALL=1000 cap and pulls full match payloads to count; add a count method to GeneticRelevanceReader
Cap the Home supplement card grid (e.g. 8) with a see-all link
Move the per-group linked tally from the your-genes widget into VariantGrouping
Home-level test for the lookUpAll rate-limited toast (4 calls, at most 3 queue)
Empty state says No supplements yet when all are still researching; show in-progress cards or reword
Remove unused $other = homeUser() or use it in guest assertions
your-genes reads the profile twice per render (itself + VariantLinks); let VariantLinks reuse it or add a write-flushed Genetics memo
Fold hasProfile into one reader call so the no-match case is one profile read
Two-user test on one reader instance proving the profile cache never serves user A's data to user B
forUserAndSupplement loads the whole research listing even on the single-supplement page; use forSupplement when the listing isn't loaded yet
Document/helper for forgetScopedInstances() in read-write-read tests now that the relevance reader is scoped
loading targets by bare action name disable every retry/lookUp button at once; target with parameters
FR-47 code-level a11y (44px targets, labels, focus ring) has no automated test; add a render test per page
Assert the '{name} queued for research.' toast on add
Upload file names wrap mid-word at 390px (Genetic Markers.cs / v); truncate with title or break at spaces
Download PDF label wraps to two lines at 390px; keep it on one line
Stored safety notes still show raw [S8] citation markers on older research rows
Escape tests with a <script> effect title and variant name on the real supplement page and genetic panel
Greeting uses now()->hour in UTC, so US evenings read Good morning; use a display timezone or pick it client-side
Waiting banner counts LookingUp rows and Home doesn't poll; count Pending/Failed for the button and show queued count
all() runs three times per Home render; memoize per request or use forSupplement() for single-supplement relevance
Genotype split into alleles four different ways; add Genotype::alleles() and use it everywhere
Home subtitle reads module contracts directly and hand-copies x-ui.panel classes; use x-ui.panel and move counts into widgets or update the plan wording
Public view helper methods (labelFor, title, meta, abbreviation, tone) are callable as Livewire actions; make them protected
'All supplements' spelled ALL=1000 and PHP_INT_MAX; use one name or a nullable limit
Fake count() ignores with() research while all() includes it
Supplement page title is always 'Supplement'; use the supplement name
Brand mark role=img label duplicates the visible app name for screen readers; mark it decorative there
